description: Ledger-indexed schedule of the project-declared treasury ASTEROID escrows: every escrow object with its exact amount, destination, finish-after and cancel-after times and a locked/releasable/expired state, plus the total escrowed amount and the next unlock. The escrow objects are ledger-verified; the treasury role of the account is an owner-confirmed declaration, and an escrow does not establish who controls the destination after release.
name: get_escrow_schedule
title: Get ASTEROID treasury escrow schedule
